summary: Sprint 28 - Mini-Gantt visual in ActionPlansView: all acceptance criteria PASSED. Logged in as admin, navigated to /audits, opened TEST_IT24_open_f3344d, switched to 'Plan de Accion' tab. Gantt renders with correct title, counter badges (5 en linea, 5 activos green, 1 vencidos red), legend (Correctiva/Preventiva/Mejora/Vencido/Hoy), month axis markers, today vertical line, and 5 colored rows with correct hex colors (corrective #D90429, preventive #F97316, improvement #2A9D8F). Empty-state verified on audit with 0 plans (TEST_IT24_open_88b772): Gantt is NOT rendered (returns null). Regression verified: 'Nuevo Plan' button and existing action plan list continue to render below Gantt correctly.

issues: First two month labels at the left edge ('ENE DE 26' and 'FEB DE 26') visually overlap because the 3-day left padding puts the first month label slightly off-viewport and behind the second. Minor cosmetic, not blocking. Consider clamping or hiding the first label if its left position is < ~3%, or increasing left padding from 3 days to ~15 days.

action_items: Optional polish: fix month axis label overlap at the left edge of the Gantt timeline (minor cosmetic).
critical_code_review_comments: ActionPlansGantt.jsx: uses p.plan_id as React key — good. No MongoDB _id exposure in UI. Component is small (~160 lines), DRY, and returns null gracefully when no plans have valid dates.
Minor: consider using date-fns for parseISO to avoid TZ issues; current parseISO appends T00:00:00 which is fine for YYYY-MM-DD but may drift in other TZ formats.
Minor: inline-style left:'min(...)' on hover tooltip uses CSS min() — works in modern browsers; OK.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded audits TEST_IT24_open_f3344d (5 plans incl. 1 overdue) and TEST_IT24_open_88b772 (0 plans).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sprint 28 Gantt feature is fully functional.
